# 1 Samuel Chapter 17 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 159v–161r | **Source Image:** 1SA_017_page_001.jpg, 1SA_017_page_002.jpg, 1SA_017_page_003.jpg, 1SA_017_page_004.jpg

---

**17:1** And-gathered [the]-Philistines their-camps for-war, and-they-were-gathered to-Socoh which [is]-to-Judah, and-they-encamped between Socoh and-between Azekah, in-Ephes-dammim.

**17:2** And-Saul and-[the]-men of-Israel gathered and-encamped in-[the]-valley of-Elah and-set-in-array [for]-battle to-meet [the]-Philistines.

**17:3** And-[the]-Philistines [were]-standing on-the-mountain from-this-side, and-Israel [was]-standing on-the-mountain from-that-side, and-the-valley [was]-between-them.

**17:4** And-went-out a-champion [ish ha-benayim] from-[the]-camps of-[the]-Philistines; Goliath [was]-his-name, from-Gath; his-height [was] six cubits and-a-span.

**17:5** And-a-helmet of-bronze [was]-upon his-head, and-a-coat-of-mail of-scales [was]-he-wearing, and-[the]-weight of-the-coat-of-mail [was] five-thousand shekels of-bronze.

**17:6** And-greaves of-bronze [were]-upon his-legs, and-a-javelin of-bronze [was]-between his-shoulders.

**17:7** And-the-shaft of-his-spear [was]-like a-weaver's beam, and-the-blade of-his-spear [was] six-hundred shekels of-iron. And-the-bearer of-the-shield [was]-going before-him.

**17:8** And-he-stood and-called to-[the]-battle-lines of-Israel and-said to-them, "Why do-you-come-out to-set-in-array [for]-battle? Am-not I the-Philistine, and-you servants of-Saul? Choose for-yourselves a-man, and-let-him-come-down to-me.

**17:9** If he-is-able to-fight with-me and-he-strikes-me, then-we-will-be to-you [as]-servants. But-if I prevail against-him and-strike-him, then-you-will-be to-us [as]-servants, and-you-will-serve us."

**17:10** And-said the-Philistine, "I defy the-battle-lines of-Israel this day. Give to-me a-man, and-we-will-fight together."

**17:11** And-heard Saul and-all Israel these words of-the-Philistine, and-they-were-dismayed and-feared exceedingly.

**17:12** And-David [was the]-son of-this Ephrathite man from-Beth-lehem of-Judah, and-his-name [was] Jesse, and-to-him [were] eight sons. And-the-man in-[the]-days of-Saul [was]-old, advanced among men.

**17:13** And-went the-three sons of-Jesse, the-great-ones, [they]-went after Saul to-the-battle. And-[the]-names of-his-three sons who went to-the-battle [were] Eliab the-firstborn, and-his-second Abinadab, and-the-third Shammah.

**17:14** And-David [was] the-youngest, and-the-three great-ones went after Saul.

**17:15** And-David [was]-going and-returning from-upon Saul, to-shepherd the-flock of-his-father at-Beth-lehem.

**17:16** And-drew-near the-Philistine early-morning and-evening and-presented-himself [for]-forty days.

**17:17** And-said Jesse to-David his-son, "Take, please, for-your-brothers this ephah of-roasted-grain and-these ten loaves, and-run to-the-camp, to-your-brothers.

**17:18** And-these ten cuts of-cheese you-shall-bring to-[the]-commander of-the-thousand. And-your-brothers you-shall-attend-to for-welfare, and-their-pledge you-shall-take."

**17:19** And-Saul and-they and-all [the]-men of-Israel [were] in-[the]-valley of-Elah, fighting with [the]-Philistines.

**17:20** And-rose-early David in-the-morning and-left the-flock with-a-keeper, and-carried and-went as-Jesse had-commanded-him. And-he-came to-the-encampment, and-the-army [was]-going-out to-the-battle-line, and-they-shouted for-the-battle.

**17:21** And-set-in-array Israel and-[the]-Philistines, battle-line to-meet battle-line.

**17:22** And-David left the-vessels from-upon-him upon-[the]-hand of-the-keeper of-the-vessels, and-ran to-the-battle-line. And-he-came and-asked for-his-brothers for-welfare [shalom].

**17:23** And-he [was]-speaking with-them, and-behold, the-champion, Goliath the-Philistine [was]-his-name, from-Gath, [was]-coming-up from-[the]-battle-lines of-[the]-Philistines, and-he-spoke according-to-these words, and-David heard.

**17:24** And-all [the]-men of-Israel, when-they-saw the-man, fled from-before-him and-feared exceedingly.

**17:25** And-said [the]-men of-Israel, "Have-you-seen this man who-is-coming-up? For to-defy Israel he-is-coming-up. And-it-will-be, the-man who strikes-him, the-king will-enrich-him [with]-great riches, and-his-daughter he-will-give to-him, and-his-father's-house he-will-make free in-Israel."

**17:26** And-said David to-the-men, the-[ones]-standing with-him, saying, "What shall-be-done for-the-man who strikes this Philistine and-removes reproach from-upon Israel? For who [is] this uncircumcised Philistine that he-should-defy the-battle-lines of-[the]-living God?"

**17:27** And-said to-him the-people according-to-this word, saying, "Thus shall-be-done for-the-man who strikes-him."

**17:28** And-heard Eliab his-eldest-brother when-he-spoke to the-men, and-burned the-anger of-Eliab against-David, and-he-said, "Why have-you-come-down? And-upon-whom did-you-leave those few sheep in-the-wilderness? I know your-presumption [zedonekha] and-the-evil of-your-heart, for to-see the-battle you-have-come-down."

**17:29** And-said David, "What have-I-done now? Is-it-not [just] a-word?"

**17:30** And-he-turned from-beside-him to-face another, and-said according-to-this word. And-the-people returned him a-word like-the-first word.

**17:31** And-were-heard the-words which David spoke, and-they-told before Saul, and-he-took-him.

**17:32** And-said David to-Saul, "Let-not-fall [the]-heart of-a-man upon-him. Your-servant will-go and-fight with this Philistine."

**17:33** And-said Saul to-David, "You-are-not-able to-go to this Philistine to-fight with-him, for a-youth [na'ar] you [are], and-he [is]-a-man of-war from-his-youth."

**17:34** And-said David to-Saul, "A-shepherd was your-servant for-his-father in-the-flock, and-came the-lion and-the-bear and-carried-off a-lamb from-the-flock.

**17:35** And-I-went-out after-him and-struck-him and-delivered [it] from-his-mouth. And-he-arose against-me, and-I-seized him by-his-beard and-struck-him and-killed-him.

**17:36** Both the-lion and the-bear your-servant struck. And-shall-be this uncircumcised Philistine as-one of-them, for he-has-defied the-battle-lines of-[the]-living God."

**17:37** And-said David, "YHWH who delivered-me from-[the]-hand of-the-lion and-from-[the]-hand of-the-bear, He will-deliver-me from-[the]-hand of-this Philistine." And-said Saul to-David, "Go, and-YHWH shall-be with-you."

**17:38** And-clothed Saul David [with]-his-garments, and-put a-helmet of-bronze upon his-head, and-clothed him [with]-a-coat-of-mail.

**17:39** And-girded David his-sword upon his-garments and-tried to-walk, for he-had-not tested [them]. And-said David to-Saul, "I-am-not-able to-walk in-these, for I-have-not tested [them]." And-David removed-them from-upon-him.

**17:40** And-he-took his-staff in-his-hand, and-chose for-himself five smooth stones from-the-wadi, and-put them in-the-shepherd's vessel which [was]-to-him, and-in-the-pouch [yalqut], and-his-sling in-his-hand. And-he-drew-near to the-Philistine.

**17:41** And-went the-Philistine, going and-drawing-near to David, and-the-man carrying the-shield [was]-before-him.

**17:42** And-looked the-Philistine and-saw David, and-he-despised-him, for he-was a-youth, and-ruddy [admoni], and-beautiful of-appearance.

**17:43** And-said the-Philistine to-David, "Am-I a-dog, that you-come to-me with-sticks [ba-maqlot]?" And-cursed the-Philistine David by-his-gods.

**17:44** And-said the-Philistine to-David, "Come to-me, and-I-will-give your-flesh to-[the]-birds of-the-heavens and-to-[the]-beasts of-the-field."

**17:45** And-said David to-the-Philistine, "You come to-me with-a-sword and-with-a-spear and-with-a-javelin, but-I come to-you in-[the]-name of-YHWH of-hosts, God of-[the]-battle-lines of-Israel, whom you have-defied.

**17:46** This day YHWH will-deliver-you into-my-hand, and-I-will-strike-you and-remove your-head from-upon-you, and-I-will-give the-carcass of-[the]-camp of-[the]-Philistines this day to-[the]-birds of-the-heavens and-to-[the]-beasts of-the-earth, and-all the-earth shall-know that there-is a-God for-Israel.

**17:47** And-shall-know all this assembly that not by-sword and-by-spear does-YHWH save, for to-YHWH [is]-the-battle, and-He-will-give you into-our-hand."

**17:48** And-it-was when the-Philistine arose and-went and-drew-near to-meet David, and-David hurried and-ran to-the-battle-line to-meet the-Philistine.

**17:49** And-David put his-hand into-the-bag and-took from-there a-stone and-slung [it] and-struck the-Philistine to his-forehead, and-sank the-stone into-his-forehead, and-he-fell upon his-face to-the-ground.

**17:50** And-David prevailed over the-Philistine with-the-sling and-with-the-stone, and-he-struck the-Philistine and-killed-him. And-[there was]-no sword in-[the]-hand of-David.

**17:51** And-ran David and-stood over the-Philistine and-took his-sword and-drew-it from-its-sheath and-killed-him and-cut-off his-head with-it. And-saw [the]-Philistines that their-champion [was]-dead, and-they-fled.

**17:52** And-arose [the]-men of-Israel and-Judah and-shouted and-pursued [the]-Philistines until-you-come [to]-the-valley and-unto [the]-gates of-Ekron. And-fell [the]-slain of-[the]-Philistines on-[the]-way of-Shaaraim and-unto Gath and-unto Ekron.

**17:53** And-returned [the]-sons of-Israel from-pursuing after [the]-Philistines and-plundered their-camps.

**17:54** And-took David the-head of-the-Philistine and-brought-it to-Jerusalem, and-his-weapons he-put in-his-tent.

**17:55** And-when-Saul-saw David going-out to-meet the-Philistine, he-said to-Abner, [the]-commander of-the-army, "Whose son [is]-this youth, Abner?" And-said Abner, "[As]-your-soul lives, the-king, I-do-not know."

**17:56** And-said the-king, "Ask, you, whose son [is]-this young-man."

**17:57** And-when-David-returned from-striking the-Philistine, and-took him Abner and-brought-him before Saul, and-[the]-head of-the-Philistine [was]-in-his-hand.

**17:58** And-said to-him Saul, "Whose son [are]-you, young-man?" And-said David, "[The]-son of-your-servant Jesse the-Bethlehemite."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

1. **17:4 — ish ha-benayim** (אִישׁ הַבֵּנַיִם): "Man of the between" — i.e., the champion who fights in the space between the two armies. EMET renders this rare term as "champion" with the literal meaning noted.

2. **17:4 — "six cubits and a span"**: The MT reads ~9 feet 9 inches. The LXX and 4QSam(a) read "four cubits and a span" (~6 feet 9 inches). The LC preserves the larger number.

3. **17:12-31 — LXX omission**: The LXX (Codex Vaticanus) omits vv. 12-31 and 55-58, which re-introduce David as if Saul doesn't know him. This is a major textual variant suggesting two originally independent traditions were combined in the MT.

4. **17:43 — ba-maqlot** (בַּמַּקְלוֹת): "With sticks" — Goliath sees David's staff and sling as the weapons of a shepherd, not a warrior. The plural "sticks" may be contemptuous.

5. **17:45 — YHWH tseva'ot**: "YHWH of hosts" — David invokes the full divine warrior title. This is the theological center of the narrative.

6. **17:54 — Jerusalem**: An anachronism if taken literally, since David had not yet captured Jerusalem (2 Sam 5). Some scholars suggest a later editorial addition.

— EMET
